neighbours.label: the word 'including' as the first word inside a parenthesis, introducing part of what was just named, as opposed to other parenthetical openers such as excluding, except or mainly
fire: The whole coast (including the northern islands) was closed to fishing.
All members (including those who joined last year) may vote in May.
Several metals (including copper and zinc) were found in the water.
Every department (including the small ones) sent a report on time.
Most birds (including the local owls) nest here in early spring.
The trust owns many buildings (including two old mills) in the valley.
Local shops (including the bakery) will close on the holiday.
Each region (including remote areas) receives money from the fund.
quiet: The whole coast (excluding the northern islands) was closed to fishing.
All members (except those who joined last year) may vote in May.
Several metals (mainly copper and zinc) were found in the water.
Every department (large or small) sent a report on time.
Most birds (about two hundred kinds) nest here in early spring.
The trust owns many buildings (some very old) in the valley.
Local shops (not the bakery) will close on the holiday.
Each region (roughly twenty) receives money from the fund.

notes: Card: 'including' x20, ' including' x6, 'also' x2, ' includes', ' Includes'. Output: promotes including, includes, encompasses, -even. Probes: (including 0.44-0.66, excluding 0.05, plain parenthetical 0.01-0.02; ' includes' 0.26, ', including' only 0.14, so the parenthesis form is what this test covers. Tokenizer: after a space, ' (' then 'including'.
